findings.title: SIGTERM seals the ledger without terminating the intercepted child
findings.evidence: Signals only set shutdown_flag (181-182); the wait loop exits on it, seals, and returns (237-253). No kill or wait follows a signal.
findings.trigger: Send SIGTERM/SIGINT while the spawned real CLI is still running.
findings.impact: The wrapper exits and reports closure while its child can continue running and modifying files outside the monitoring lifetime.

findings.title: Persistence failures are discarded while closure is reported successful
findings.evidence: FS_EVENT inserts discard Result at 211; CLOSURE_SEAL insert discards Result at 248 followed by unconditional closure output at 249-250 and Ok at 253.
findings.trigger: An insert fails, for example because another writer advanced the head (122-123), disk is full, or SQLite rejects the write.
findings.impact: Events or the final seal are absent despite successful process status and closure output; callers cannot distinguish audit loss.

findings.title: Specification-only consolidation emits verified and consolidated results
findings.evidence: Missing evaluator sets verified=True (561-563), and consolidated derives solely from verified_count (619). main_dispatcher.py:807-832 passes None unless --execute and serializes these fields; JSON lacks a mode field.
findings.trigger: Call execute_consolidation without a gate evaluator, or the CLI consolidate21 JSON path without --execute.
findings.impact: Consumers receive 21 verified outcomes and consolidated=true without running gates. This is a misleading evidence receipt, not evidence of a runtime authorization bypass.

findings.title: Timed-out consolidation gate subprocesses are left running
findings.evidence: create_subprocess_shell at 638 and wait_for(proc.communicate()) at 644-647 are followed by timeout return at 652-653, with no terminate/kill/wait cleanup.
findings.trigger: A gate exceeds timeout_s; cmd_consolidate21 --execute supplies this evaluator (main_dispatcher.py:807-812).
findings.impact: The gate and shell descendants can continue consuming resources and writing output after the topology reports timeout, overlapping later work.

findings.title: Canonical seal digest changes with optional dependency installation
findings.evidence: _canonical_blake3_hex returns BLAKE3 when import succeeds (35-37), otherwise prefixed SHA-256 (38-39). Both flow into identical receipt fields without an algorithm identifier.
findings.trigger: Replay the same logical tick and outcomes in environments with and without blake3.
findings.impact: Identical causal data yields incompatible evidence, squad and Merkle digests despite the deterministic canonical receipt contract.

findings.title: BFT persistence explicitly weakens required durability
findings.evidence: persist_bft_event sets journal_mode=WAL then synchronous=NORMAL before commit; the canonical rules require transactional persistence synchronous=FULL.
findings.trigger: A caller uses persist_bft_event and the host loses power after an acknowledged commit.
findings.impact: The helper provides weaker durability than its BFT persistence contract. No production callers were found in targeted Python searches, so deployed reachability is not established.

findings.title: Deskimming dry-run writes and replaces its audit receipt
findings.evidence: --dry-run is documented as simulate without writing (111), but audit directories are created at import (30-31) and receipt_file is opened with w unconditionally (102-104).
findings.trigger: Run the script with --dry-run after a prior real receipt exists.
findings.impact: The preview mutates the filesystem and overwrites prior audit evidence with a simulated receipt.

findings.title: Autocognition audit asserts checks it never performs
findings.evidence: Generated YAML hardcodes ANNIHILATED_ZERO_CIRCULAR_LOOPS, 0 ruff issues/0 clippy warnings, no orphaned branches and ZERO_NOISE_ACCUMULATION_VERIFIED (185-190). The function only computes transcript metrics then persists the artifact.
findings.trigger: Run run_autocognition_audit in a checkout with lint issues, orphan branches, loops, or no transcript (103-112).
findings.impact: The produced audit declares verified cleanup and tool results without obtaining them, creating false evidence for downstream readers.

findings.title: Explicit conversation selection is ignored in favor of another session
findings.evidence: get_conversation_id evaluates environment values without assigning/returning them at 28; it selects the UUID directory with newest mtime at 43-45, which feeds TRANSCRIPT_PATH at 52.
findings.trigger: Set CONVERSATION_ID or ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID to an active session while another UUID directory has newer mtime.
findings.impact: The audit reads and attributes metrics to a different conversation, breaking its stated active-session scope.
